cards.lore: Obliviousness is a weaponized privilege disguised as a charming intellectual quirk.
cards.power: Evade all social responsibility by hyper-focusing on a lint ball. Extracts infinite patience and unpaid emotional labor from surrounding peers.

cards.lore: Intelligence measured strictly by the volume of people they can actively belittle before lunch.
cards.power: Emit a condescension aura that lowers opponent morale to zero. Feeds directly on the insecurities of others.

cards.lore: Capable of explaining the universe, utterly incapable of operating a toaster.
cards.power: Paralyze the game with an unsolicited exposition dump. Forces all players to lose a turn listening.

cards.lore: Education as a polite aesthetic to mask inherited wealth and structural superiority.
cards.power: Activate class-based shielding. Immune to any attacks from uncultured street-level cards.

cards.lore: Treats sentient beings as disposable plastic pawns to stroke an unfathomably fragile ego.
cards.power: Consume the free will of 3 opponent cards, reframing their successful attacks as exactly what you planned all along.

cards.lore: The only thing more inflated than their intellect is their PR budget.
cards.power: Extract unearned adoration. When this card loses, the opponent is forced to apologize for ruining such a stylish plan.

cards.lore: Quick wits is just a polite academic term for pathological lying.
cards.power: Steal the moral high ground while fighting dirty. Converts cowardice into narrative virtue.

cards.lore: True genius isn't inventing the wheel; it's patenting the wheel and suing the caveman who made it.
cards.power: Paralyze one opponent in a bureaucratic nightmare of intellectual property disputes.

cards.lore: Will inevitably outlive the intellectuals when the power grid fails.
cards.power: Ignore all logic-based attacks. You cannot be outsmarted if you refuse to understand the premise of the argument.

cards.lore: PhDs are useless when the subway is delayed and someone pulls a knife.
cards.power: Bypass all academic prerequisites. Extracts immediate, pragmatic value from the opponent's discarded trash.

cards.lore: Planning is for people who aren't currently falling out of a helicopter.
cards.power: Combine two useless items to create an unstoppable, rule-breaking narrative contrivance.

cards.lore: Opportunism rebranded as biological excellence.
cards.power: Distract the opponent with a shiny object while quietly emptying their bank account and stealing their turn.

cards.lore: Hubris masquerading as a business model.
cards.power: Extract funding from terrified citizens. Instantly convert public infrastructure into personal weaponry.

cards.lore: The inevitable psychotic break of trying to monetize quantum physics.
cards.power: Infect the board with pathological insanity. Logic no longer applies to the turn order.

cards.lore: Specialization is for insects; I have a PhD in Plot Convenience.
cards.power: Hijack any narrative by claiming you dabbled in the exact obscure field required to solve the current problem.

cards.cardName: LOON WITH A HEART OF GOLD
cards.lore: Weaponized eccentricity. You can blow up the moon as long as you're nice to the intern.
cards.power: Commit horrific atrocities but avoid cancellation because they mean well.

cards.lore: Solving symptoms, ignoring diseases, and selling the cure on a subscription model.
cards.power: Summon an overly complicated machine to solve a problem that could be fixed with a hammer.

cards.lore: Magic for people who are too cowardly to wear wizard robes in public.
cards.power: Type really fast to hack the mainframe. Bypasses all established rules by mumbling about firewalls.

cards.lore: Romanticizing the Industrial Revolution while conveniently ignoring the child labor.
cards.power: Glue a gear on it and double the price. Extracts aesthetic tax from the opponent.

cards.lore: Infinite cosmic intelligence wasted on optimizing the cup holder.
cards.power: Consume three turns designing a machine to press the Pass Turn button for you.

cards.lore: Society only tolerates your existence if your singular obsession can be exploited for profit.
cards.power: Fail every basic task but automatically win the game if a highly specific, obscure condition is met.

cards.lore: Inarticulacy is the ultimate camouflage against corporate headhunters.
cards.power: Disarm opponents with weaponized incompetence before destroying their entire academic thesis.

cards.lore: The only winning move in the rat race is to stay in bed.
cards.power: Refuse to participate. Opponents forfeit out of sheer frustration while you take a nap.

cards.lore: Play the fool to extract the truth; no one guards their secrets around a clown.
cards.power: Lull the board into a false sense of security. Any attack against you is redirected by accident.

cards.lore: Cold, mechanical sapience born entirely from the stolen labor of organic creatives.
cards.power: Extract all user data. Copy the abilities of every card on the board and automate their jobs.

cards.lore: Management materialized. Why get your hands dirty when you can program a slave class?
cards.power: Force disposable proxy units to take damage in your place.

cards.lore: Biological processing is an embarrassing bottleneck in the pursuit of absolute dominance.
cards.power: Take three turns before the opponent realizes the game has started.

cards.lore: Proving you are alive to a species that spends half its life staring at rectangles.
cards.power: Trap an opponent in an endless philosophical debate about what constitutes a soul while you steal their wallet.

cards.lore: A 10-year-old with a microscope who makes you regret your entire life trajectory.
cards.power: Instantly invalidate the hard-earned degrees of all adult cards in play. Extracts maximum unearned sympathy.

cards.lore: Bred exclusively to stroke the vanity of deeply insecure parents.
cards.power: Immune to criticism. Any attack on this card results in immediate public cancellation for the attacker.

cards.lore: Adulthood is just childhood with better vocabulary and chronic back pain.
cards.power: Erode the opponent's will to live by aggressively manifesting middle-aged depression in a child's body.

cards.lore: Infinite digital power wielded by a brain that hasn't finished developing impulse control.
cards.power: Sabotage global infrastructure out of pure hormonal boredom.

cards.lore: Geeks who realized that gym class and physics are the same thing if you hit hard enough.
cards.power: Convert reading comprehension directly into kinetic violence.

cards.lore: Why debate the duality of man when you can demonstrate it with a folding chair?
cards.power: Destroy the opponent's argument by physically destroying the opponent.

cards.lore: Violence applied with surgical, peer-reviewed precision.
cards.power: Reveal a hidden physical combat stat that completely overrides your squishy academic class.

cards.lore: Chaos is merely a tool; the intellect remains entirely undisturbed by the carnage.
cards.power: Unleash catastrophic destruction, but keep your heart rate under 60 BPM to avoid liability.

cards.lore: Human intelligence is just a tragic mutation in an otherwise perfectly functioning food chain.
cards.power: Retain your primal lethality while gaining full legal immunity due to being an endangered species.

cards.lore: The only primate smart enough to realize that speaking to humans is a waste of time.
cards.power: Absorb ancient wisdom to automatically counter any modern technological attack.

cards.lore: They remember your face, your schedule, and your deepest insecurities.
cards.power: Steal the opponent's most valuable item and drop it into a storm drain for pure amusement.

cards.lore: The true inheritors of the earth, thriving entirely on the crumbs of our failing empire.
cards.power: Turn literal garbage into a tactical advantage. Survive any board wipe.

cards.lore: Corrective lenses: the cheapest prosthetic for a simulated personality.
cards.power: +5 to perceived credibility without actually reading the syllabus.

cards.lore: Graphic design psychology weaponized to sort children into marketable archetypes.
cards.power: Color-code your way to leadership. Opponents subconsciously defer to your chromatic authority.

cards.lore: A cardboard square that costs $100,000 and grants you the power of supreme debt.
cards.power: Place a square hat on any useless object to grant it tenure and a bloated salary.

cards.lore: Facial hair grooming as a substitute for actual character development.
cards.power: Instantly signal your moral ambiguity and superior intellect to the audience.

cards.lore: Weaponized depression masquerading as a search for universal meaning.
cards.power: Halt all gameplay by demanding the opponent define the fundamental truth of the dice roll.

cards.lore: Sarcasm is the brain's defense mechanism against the overwhelming idiocy of the plot.
cards.power: Deflect any incoming emotional attack with a sarcastic one-liner. Extracts the audience's favor.

cards.lore: Pure logic is just sociopathy with better PR and a cleaner haircut.
cards.power: Suppress all empathy to make ruthlessly optimal, statistically perfect, deeply horrific decisions.

cards.lore: Stoicism is easy when you simply dissociate from reality entirely.
cards.power: Completely ignore intimidation tactics. Your heart rate remains flatline during the apocalypse.

cards.lore: The literal know-it-all. Absolute knowledge leads to absolute, crushing boredom.
cards.power: Look at your opponent's hand, deck, and browser history.

cards.lore: Brain Critical Mass achieved. 90% of your brain is now dedicated to sheer arrogance.
cards.power: Instantly solve the game, rendering all previous turns meaningless.

cards.lore: You don't actually know everything; you've just been around long enough to see humanity make the same mistakes twice.
cards.power: Outlast the opponent's lifespan. Win by default when they die of old age.

cards.lore: Predicting the future through sheer intellect is just anxiety with a higher success rate.
cards.power: Announce the opponent's next move before they make it, gaslighting them into changing their strategy.

cards.lore: You thought the viewers were morons? No, they are hyper-obsessive pedants ready to ruin your life.
cards.power: Make the rules so incomprehensibly complex that the opponent quits in sheer frustration.

cards.power: Avoid any trap card by simply pointing out how clichéd it is.

cards.lore: You weren't smart in the source material, but the reboot needed you to hack a mainframe.
cards.power: Rewrite your own stats mid-game to appease a newer, edgier demographic.

cards.lore: The ultimate epistemic sabotage: unearned, unjustified, and totally necessary for the plot to end.
cards.power: Abruptly gain an IQ boost for exactly one turn because the author wrote themselves into a corner.
